Source introduction:
Jeanine Driscoll (Republican Party, Conservative Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent New York's 4th Congressional District. Driscoll is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. Driscoll advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026. The Conservative Party primary for this office on June 23, 2026, was canceled.

A named voter guide/Sway voting group is a recommendation, not automatically a formal endorsement.
